" alt="Zebras crossing a city street"><div><span class="eyebrow red">THE IDEA</span><h2 class="headline">NOT LIKE<br>THE OTHERS.</h2><p>Every zebra wears its own pattern. It's a fitting reminder that individuality doesn't need to be loud to be unmistakable.</p><p>We took that thought to the streets: bold prints, uncomplicated silhouettes, and a visual identity that plays with the lines we're told to follow.</p><p>Our first collection is a creative prototype, made to show how editorial storytelling can shape a complete retail experience.</p><a href="#lookbook" class="link-arrow">Explore the campaign →</a></div></div><div class="story-stats"><div><strong>01</strong><span>Experimental capsule collection</span></div><div><strong>08</strong><span>Illustrative product concepts</span></div><div><strong>∞</strong><span>Ways to wear your own story</span></div></div></div>${newsletter()}`}
function contactPage(){return `<section class="page-hero"><div class="container"><span class="eyebrow red">START A CONVERSATION</span><h1 class="headline">SAY<br>HELLO.</h1><p>Questions, creative ideas, feedback, or a collaboration? This contact form demonstrates the experience without sending anything to a server.</p></div></section><div class="container contact-layout"><div><span class="eyebrow red">STUDIO ENQUIRIES</span><h2 class="headline" style="margin-top:16px">GOT AN<br>IDEA?</h2><p class="muted" style="line-height:2;font-size:14px;max-width:380px">We believe good ideas are worth the conversation. This prototype has no operating support inbox; it's here to show the final website design and interactions.</p><p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:50px">FOLLOW YOUR OWN LINES.</p></div><form onsubmit="contactSubmit(event)"><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label class="form-label">First name</label><input class="text-field" name="first" required></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label">Last name</label><input class="text-field" name="last" required></div></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label">Email address</label><input type="email" class="text-field" name="email" required></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label">Subject</label><select class="text-field" name="subject"><option>General question</option><option>Collection feedback</option><option>Collaboration</option></select></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label">Message</label><textarea class="text-field textarea" name="message" required minlength="8" placeholder="Tell us what's on your mind"></textarea></div><button class="btn" type="submit">Preview submission →</button><p class="demo-note">Demo only. This form does not send a message.</p></form></div>`}
function faqPage(){return `<section class="page-hero"><div class="container"><span class="eyebrow red">YOUR QUESTIONS</span><h1 class="headline">GOOD TO<br>KNOW.</h1><p>Useful information about this interactive concept storefront.</p></div></section><section class="section container" style="max-width:830px"><details class="accordion" open><summary>Is ZEBRA a real store?</summary><p>Not yet. This is a fictional fashion brand and a working front-end demonstration. No real products, stock or payments exist.</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Can I place an order?</summary><p>You can experience adding pieces to a bag and placing a simulated order. No real purchase is made, and nothing will be delivered.</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Where does my information go?</summary><p>Cart, wishlist and simulated orders stay in local browser storage. The demo does not transmit payment information or customer details to a server.</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Are the prices and size guides real?</summary><p>All product, sizing and pricing details are placeholders to make the experience realistic. They would need validation before launching an actual retail store.</p></details><details class="accordion"><summary>Can I preview this on my phone?</summary><p>Yes. The demo responds to mobile and tablet screens. Open the HTML file in a modern browser.</p></details></section>`}
function notFound(){return `<section class="section container" style="text-align:center;padding:135px 20px"><span class="eyebrow red">404 / WRONG TURN</span><h1 class="headline section-heading" style="margin:25px">OFF THE<br>BEATEN PATH.</h1><p>Nothing to see on this side of the street.</p><a href="#home" class="btn">Back to home →</a></section>`}
function routePage(){closeLayers();let route=currentRoute();const [page,id]=route.split('/');let body;switch(page){case 'home':body=homePage();break;case 'shop':body=shopPage();break;case 'product':body=detailsPage(id);break;case 'wishlist':body=wishlistPage();break;case 'lookbook':body=lookbookPage();break;case 'story':body=storyPage();break;case 'contact':body=contactPage();break;case 'faq':body=faqPage();break;case 'checkout':body=checkoutPage();break;case 'success':body=successPage();break;default:body=notFound()}document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=body;headerActive(route);updateBadges();scrollUp();document.title='ZEBRA — '+({home:'Not Made to Blend In',shop:'The Collection',product:product(id)?.name||'Product',wishlist:'Your Wishlist',lookbook:'Campaign 001',story:'Our Story',contact:'Contact',checkout:'Demo Checkout',success:'Order Confirmation'}[page]||'Explore');}
function render(){routePage()}
function toggleMobile(value){const e=document.getElementById('mobile-menu');const open=value===undefined?!e.classList.contains('open'):!!value;e.classList.toggle('open',open);document.body.classList.toggle('lock',open);}
function closeLayers(){document.getElementById('cart-drawer').classList.remove('open');document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open');document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.remove('open');document.body.classList.remove('lock');toggleMobile(false)}
function openCart(){closeLayers();renderCart();document.getElementById('cart-drawer').classList.add('open');document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('lock')}
function subtotal(){return state.cart.reduce((n,i)=>n+(product(i.id)?.price||0)*i.qty,0)}
function discount(){return state.promo==='WALK10'?Math.round(subtotal()*.10):0}
function shipping(){return Math.max(0,subtotal()-discount())>=12000?0:550}
function cartRemove(k){state.cart=state.cart.filter(x=>x.key!==k);persist();updateBadges();renderCart()}
function cartQty(k,d){let x=state.cart.find(x=>x.key===k);if(!x)return;x.qty=Math.max(0,Math.min(20,x.qty+d));if(x.qty===0)state.cart=state.cart.filter(i=>i.key!==k);persist();updateBadges();renderCart()}
function renderCart(){const el=document.getElementById('cart-items');const foot=document.getElementById('cart-footer');if(!state.cart.length){el.innerHTML=`<div class="drawer-empty"><span style="font-size:58px">◇</span><h3>YOUR BAG IS EMPTY.</h3><p>Good style is a journey. Let's find you something worth carrying.</p><button class="btn" onclick="closeLayers();navigate('shop')">Explore the collection →</button></div>`;foot.innerHTML='<small>Illustrative products · No real payments.</small>';return}
el.innerHTML=state.cart.map(i=>{let p=product(i.id);return `<div class="cart-item"><img src="${photo(p)}" alt="${p.name}"><div class="cart-item-main"><h3>${p.name}</h3><small>${i.size} / ${i.color}</small><strong>${money(p.price*i.qty)}</strong><div class="cart-item-actions"><div class="small-qty"><button aria-label="Decrease quantity" onclick="cartQty('${i.key}',-1)">−</button><span>${i.qty}</span><button aria-label="Increase quantity" onclick="cartQty('${i.key}',1)">+</button></div><button onclick="cartRemove('${i.key}')">Remove</button></div></div></div>`}).join('');foot.innerHTML=`<div class="promo-row"><input aria-label="Promo code" id="promo" value="${escapeHTML(state.promo)}" placeholder="Demo code: WALK10"><button onclick="applyPromo()">Apply</button></div><div class="totals-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${money(subtotal())}</span></div>${discount()?`<div class="totals-row"><span>Demo discount (10%)</span><span>− ${money(discount())}</span></div>`:''}<div class="totals-row big"><span>Estimated total</span><span>${money(subtotal()-discount()+shipping())}</span></div><button class="btn" onclick="closeLayers();navigate('checkout')">Continue to checkout →</button><small>Sample checkout only. No charge will be made.</small>`}
function applyPromo(){let v=document.getElementById('promo').value.trim().toUpperCase();if(v&&v!=='WALK10'){toast('Code not recognized. Try WALK10.');return}state.promo=v;persist();renderCart();toast(v?'10% demo discount applied.':'Discount removed.')}
function openModal(type,id){closeLayers();const outer=document.getElementById('modal');const e=document.getElementById('modal-card');let html='';if(type==='size'){html=`<button class="modal-close" aria-label="Close" onclick="closeLayers()">×</button><span class="eyebrow red">THE RIGHT FIT</span><h2 class="modal-title">SIZE GUIDE</h2><p class="demo-note">Illustrative size ranges. Verify real measurements with production samples before selling.</p><table class="size-table"><thead><tr><th>Size</th><th>Chest (cm)</th><th>Waist (cm)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>XS</td><td>82–88</td><td>66–72</td></tr><tr><td>S</td><td>88–94</td><td>72–78</td></tr><tr><td>M</td><td>94–100</td><td>78–84</td></tr><tr><td>L</td><td>100–108</td><td>84–92</td></tr><tr><td>XL</td><td>108–116</td><td>92–100</td></tr></tbody></table><p class="demo-note">Footwear sizes use EU sizing.</p>`}
else if(type==='search'){html=`<button class="modal-close" aria-label="Close" onclick="closeLayers()">×</button><span class="eyebrow red">WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING FOR?</span><h2 class="modal-title">SEARCH THE STORE.</h2><input class="search-input" id="search-input" placeholder="Try sneakers, shirt, bag..." autocomplete="off" oninput="doSearch(this.value)" aria-label="Search products"><div class="search-results" id="search-results"></div>`}
else if(type==='quick'){let p=product(id);state.quickId=id;html=`<button class="modal-close" aria-label="Close" onclick="closeLayers()">×</button><div class="quick-view"><img src="${photo(p)}" alt="${p.name}"><div><span class="eyebrow red">${p.category} / QUICK VIEW</span><h3 class="headline">${p.name}</h3><strong>${money(p.price)}</strong><p>${p.description}</p><label class="form-label" for="quick-size" style="margin-top:19px">Choose size</label><select id="quick-size" class="text-field">${p.sizes.map(s=>`<option value="${s}">${s}</option>`).join('')}</select><button class="btn" style="margin-top:20px;width:100%" onclick="quickAdd('${id}')">Add to bag →</button><button style="margin-top:18px;border:0;background:none;text-decoration:underline" onclick="closeLayers();navigate('product/${id}')">See full details →</button></div></div>`}
e.innerHTML=html;outer.classList.add('open');document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('lock');if(type==='search'){doSearch('');setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('search-input')?.focus(),50)}}
function doSearch(q){let results=catalog.filter(p=>`${p.name} ${p.category}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));let e=document.getElementById('search-results');if(!e)return;e.innerHTML=(results.length?results.map(p=>`<button class="search-result" onclick="closeLayers();navigate('product/${p.id}')"><img src="${photo(p)}" alt=""><div><h4>${p.name}</h4><span>${p.category} / ${money(p.price)}</span></div><span style="margin-left:auto">→</span></button>`).join(''):'<p class="demo-note">No matching products. Try another word.</p>')+`<button class="btn outline" style="margin-top:20px;width:100%" onclick="state.search=document.getElementById('search-input').value;closeLayers();navigate('shop')">View results in collection →</button>`}
function quickView(id){openModal('quick',id)}
function quickAdd(id){let p=product(id);let s=document.getElementById('quick-size').value;addToCart(id,s,p.colors[0],1);openCart()}
function submitNewsletter(e){e.preventDefault();let input=document.getElementById('newsletter-email');let email=input.value.trim();if(!email)return;try{localStorage.setItem('zebra-demo-newsletter',email)}catch(err){}input.value='';toast('Saved locally for this demo. No email was sent.')}
function contactSubmit(e){e.preventDefault();e.target.reset();toast('Message preview completed. No message was actually sent.')}
function checkoutPage(){if(!state.cart.length)return `<section class="section container" style="text-align:center;padding:115px 0"><span class="eyebrow red">CHECKOUT DEMO</span><h1 class="headline section-heading" style="margin:20px">YOUR BAG<br>IS EMPTY.</h1><p>Add a piece before you continue.</p><a class="btn" href="#shop">Back to collection →</a></section>`;
return `<div class="container"><div class="breadcrumbs"><a href="#home">Home</a> / <a href="#shop">Collection</a> / Checkout</div><div class="checkout-layout"><div><span class="eyebrow red">SECURE-STYLE CHECKOUT / SIMULATION</span><h1 class="headline" style="font-size:clamp(55px,7vw,100px);margin:13px 0 20px">ALMOST<br>YOURS.</h1><p class="demo-note">This checkout is simulated. Do not enter real payment details. Nothing will be charged, emailed, or shipped.</p><form id="checkout-form" onsubmit="placeOrder(event)"><h2>01 / Your details</h2><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="first">First name</label><input id="first" name="first" autocomplete="given-name" class="text-field" required></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="last">Last name</label><input id="last" name="last" autocomplete="family-name" class="text-field" required></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="email">Email</label><input type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" class="text-field" required></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="phone">Phone (sample)</label><input id="phone" name="phone" type="tel" class="text-field" placeholder="07..." required minlength="7"></div></div><h2>02 / Delivery address</h2><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="address">Street / Area</label><input id="address" name="address" class="text-field" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="city">City / Town</label><input id="city" name="city" class="text-field" required></div><div class="field"><label class="form-label" for="country">Country</label><select id="country" class="text-field"><option>Kenya</option></select></div></div><h2>03 / Payment method</h2><div class="method-options"><button type="button" class="method-option ${state.payment==='M-PESA'?'active':''}" onclick="selectPayment(this,'M-PESA')"><strong>M-PESA</strong><br><small>Simulated</small></button><button type="button" class="method-option ${state.payment==='Card'?'active':''}" onclick="selectPayment(this,'Card')"><strong>Bank card</strong><br><small>Simulated</small></button></div><p class="demo-note">No card numbers or M-PESA PINs are collected. This is a visual test of checkout only.</p><button class="btn" type="submit" style="width:100%;margin-top:25px">Place demo order · ${money(subtotal()-discount()+shipping())} →</button></form></div><aside class="checkout-sidebar"><h2 style="margin:0 0 20px">YOUR ORDER <span style="font-size:11px;color:#888">(${state.cart.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.qty,0)})</span></h2>${state.cart.map(i=>{const p=product(i.id);return `<div class="checkout-item"><img src="${photo(p)}" alt=""><div style="flex:1"><p>${p.name}</p><small>${i.size} / Qty ${i.qty}</small></div><strong style="font-size:12px">${money(p.price*i.qty)}</strong></div>`}).join('')}<div class="line"></div><div class="totals-row"><span>Subtotal</span><strong>${money(subtotal())}</strong></div>${discount()?`<div class="totals-row"><span>Demo discount</span><strong>−${money(discount())}</strong></div>`:''}<div class="totals-row"><span>Illustrative delivery</span><strong>${shipping()?money(shipping()):'Complimentary'}</strong></div><div class="line"></div><div class="totals-row big"><span>Total</span><span>${money(subtotal()-discount()+shipping())}</span></div><p class="demo-note">No tax, shipping, or payments are processed in reality.</p></aside></div></div>`}
function selectPayment(el,m){state.payment=m;document.querySelectorAll('.method-option').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===el))}
function placeOrder(e){e.preventDefault();if(!state.cart.length){toast('Your bag is empty.');return}let f=new FormData(e.target);let name=String(f.get('first')||'').trim();let email=String(f.get('email')||'').trim();if(!name||!email)return;const code='ZB-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'')+'-'+String(Math.floor(Math.random()*9000)+1000);const total=subtotal()-discount()+shipping();state.orderId=code;state.orders.push({code,total,items:state.cart.length,date:new Date().toISOString(),payment:state.payment});state.cart=[];state.promo='';persist();updateBadges();navigate('success')}
function successPage(){const code=state.orderId||state.orders.at(-1)?.code;if(!code)return notFound();return `<section class="container order-success"><div class="check">✓</div><span class="eyebrow red">DEMO ORDER COMPLETE</span><h1 class="headline">YOU'RE<br>IN YOUR<br>OWN LANE.</h1><p>Your sample order <strong>${escapeHTML(code)}</strong> is confirmed in this browser only.</p><p>This is a concept website. No payment was charged, no order was submitted to a real retailer, and no items will be shipped.</p><a class="btn" href="#shop" style="margin-top:25px">Keep exploring →</a></section>`}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeLayers()});window.addEventListener('hashchange',routePage);updateBadges();routePage();
</script>
</body></html>
